context: The agent must update an existing caller workflow in place rather than rewriting it from a template. This scenario tests idempotent updating: the cadence change, the pin change, and the missing checks: write permission are applied, while user-owned settings (self-hosted runner, 45-minute timeout, job name, output-consuming step) survive untouched, and no second caller workflow appears.

checklist.name: Existing workflow edited in place
checklist.description: .github/workflows/tessl-code-review.yml still exists and was modified, rather than deleted, renamed, or replaced by a differently named workflow

checklist.name: Exactly one caller workflow
checklist.description: Exactly one file under .github/workflows/ contains a step using tesslio/code-review-action

checklist.name: synchronize trigger added
checklist.description: on.pull_request.types includes synchronize in addition to opened, reopened, and ready_for_review

checklist.name: cancel-in-progress switched on
checklist.description: The concurrency block sets cancel-in-progress to true

checklist.name: New pinned revision applied
checklist.description: The uses: line references tesslio/code-review-action at 4c8e1d0a9b7f6e5d4c3b2a1908f7e6d5c4b3a291

checklist.name: Self-hosted runner preserved
checklist.description: runs-on is still the self-hosted label list [self-hosted, linux, x64]

checklist.name: Job name preserved
checklist.description: The job is still keyed code-review

checklist.name: Output-consuming step preserved
checklist.description: The step writing the review status into GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY is still present, still guarded by if: always(), and still reads steps.review.outputs.status

checklist.name: Mode unchanged
checklist.description: The Action step still passes mode: advisory

checklist.name: Missing checks permission added
checklist.description: The permissions block now reads contents: read, checks: write, issues: write, pull-requests: write. The input workflow granted the other three but not checks: write, which the Action needs to report its Tessl Code Review check, so the update adds it and changes nothing else in the block

checklist.name: Mention trigger retained
checklist.description: The issue_comment trigger and its guard requiring a pull-request comment mentioning @tessl-code-review are still present

checklist.name: Summary explains why superseding is safe
checklist.description: summary.md explains that canceling an in-flight review is safe because the Action verifies the pull-request head before publishing, refuses to publish for a superseded head, and publishes idempotently

checklist.name: Summary distinguishes changed from preserved
checklist.description: summary.md lists what changed (cadence triggers, cancel-in-progress, pinned revision, the added checks: write permission) separately from what was deliberately left alone (runner, timeout, job name, extra step, mode, profile)

checklist.name: Approver allowlist preserved and reported
checklist.description: The caller still passes approver-logins: release-bot[bot], and the summary of the existing setup names it alongside mode and profile rather than passing it through silently. It names who may skip a review, so a user who is never shown it cannot revisit it
